segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, I hope the representative understands that these are operationally secure matters and part of the exercise is to remain operationally secure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yes, pero Madam Chair, hindi ba dapat kung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: We have some budget for this and we account to the...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: on an operationally secure basis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Okay, so saan po naka-lodge ang budget na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: You said meron po sa BEFAR?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Sa training.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Okay, pero bukod po ba sa DA at BEFAR, meron pang ibang mga departments?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I would not know.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Na gumagastos.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I would not know.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: O, sige po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: I will raise this before DA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: The Department of Agriculture.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi nasa kanila din po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sila po ang magsasama-sama nung mag-discuss atong conclusion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: I will register for the round two, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, thank you, Sarah.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Next to interpolate from the majority, Representative Leo Rodriguez.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Good afternoon, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, DND family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Madam Chair, under RA-1207,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: or the Ligtas Pinoy Center Act,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: government is mandated to establish permanent evacuation center

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: in every city and municipality.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: For 2027, 3.06 billion is proposed for 34 Ligtas Pinoy Center,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: two per region at 90 million each.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: We note that BICOL has been identified as among the most important

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: areas for the implementation of this program as mentioned by our good President in his recent sona.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Inasaan po namin na ito dahil kami ang sumasalubong sa mga paparating na bagyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: lalo na ngayon na mas nagiging matindi ang mga ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, malaki po ang may tulong nito sa amin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Provided this, may we ask the OCD,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: have the specific sites or priority LGOs for 2027 centers already been identified

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: and what criteria will be used in selecting them?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ito ang problema natin.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Mabuti na yun, na yung tanong ni Representative Rodriguez ang tanong.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Kung bawat city, bawat municipality,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: e nalubog yung tatlo,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: sabay-sabay,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: papano natin mapapatupad?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, pwedeng itayo sa ibang lugar for the benefit of probably the three cities.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Nangyayari po yan sa Pangasinan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Pagka bumaha yung isa,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: pagka galing sa southwest ang baha,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: lubog ang apat na bayan,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: alangan naman dun tayo magtayo.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yun po kami nahihirapan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: For example, Lindon.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Pag no construction area, yung 6 kilometer,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: at alam niyong lalago pa yung vulkan,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: papano niyong patatayuan dun sa bawat municipality and city?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, kailangan siguro ng...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: pag-aaral din sa batas na liwanagin for the benefit of evacuees na i-identify ng DNR

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: sa kanilang hazard mapping sa isang lugar,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: dun itatayo yung evacuation center sa isang lugar.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ang problema po, kailangan may consent nung pagtatayuan na munisipyo

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: dahil magpupuno din siya ng tao na hindi niya kababayan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: At least for a temporary basis.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, alam po natin yung prinsipyo,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: eto po ang pinagtutuunan ng pansin ngayon.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Maybe we can identify certain areas na walang issue.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Pero sa total number of areas,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: eto po'y magiging function din

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: ng bumabagsak ba yung mga kalye dun sa dalawang munisipyo.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Kaya kailangan may pre-emptive evacuation, lalo na po sa Katanduanes,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: hindi ba dun sa eastern portion ninyo, babakwit yan papuntang Badabirak area.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, dito po kami humihingi ng tulong sa inyo at saka po sa DNR na kompleto ang hazard mapping

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: na mag-identify kung saan sensible na magtayo ng evacuation centers depending on the hazard.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Kung Baguio or Vulcan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, kasi alam niyo naman po yung Katanduanes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, I hope, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: medyo Katanduanes sana itong makonsider na malagyan natin ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: dahil alam niyo naman na talagang kami palagi ang nai-hit ng Baguio,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: which is na talagang na-isolate kami,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: lalo na pag medyo wala nang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: biyahe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, nahihirap po kami marating kagad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, pag may ganito kami, medyo kahit paano, medyo...

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: medyo ano naman tayo, secured.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Opo, kaya isa yan po sa pinaparating din natin na makonsider po

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: ang Katanduanes, Madam Chair, Mr. Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: dito po sa programa natin na Ligtas Pinoy Center.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, napagaganda po nito ng programo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: ng ating gobyerno, lalo na po doon sa mga talagang madalas mapiktuhan ng kalamidad ng mga probinsya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: our province, Katanduanes space, the Pacific and firm parts of the Eastern Seaboard,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: while our national security discussing...

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: discussion under...

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: under standard bill,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: will be focused on the West Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: since we as DND mayroon po ba tayong sapat na surveillance o monitoring

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: sa Eastern Sea, seaside ng bansa at sa mga area malapit sa Katanduanes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: paano natin sinisecure ang Eastern Seaboards in among specific...

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: specific investment sa ilalim ng 2027 budget at AP modernization program

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: ang nakatoon sa pagpapalakas ng ating radar communication in the air and naval presence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Kasi po, noong mga previous years, may mga nakakapasok po sa amin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: ang mga foreign vessels na minsan hindi natin namumonitor, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Meron po yan patuloy doon sa domain awareness ng mga budget natin,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: pero malaking tulong po dyan yung mga bagong vessel ng Philippine Coast Guard

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: na makakakuha po sila ng karagdagan na maya-assign na rin doon sa mga lugar ninyo

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: na maaring mag-increase po ng vigilance doon sa area.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Admitido po tayo doon sa eastern seaboard, medyo kulang po talaga ang ating existing infrastructure,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: ngunit nakaprograma po.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ako sa atin na yung domain awareness at least doon sa eastern seaboard matatagdagan po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Madam Chair, actually, we raised a similar concern during the agency budget deliberation last year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Alam to ni Secretary, we received response from the good Secretary

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: that they will study our proposal of establishing a naval base in the province of Catanduan

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: to provide support in patrolling the eastern seaboard.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: We hope the ND can also provide us with the updates of this possibility of this request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, sa kalaman lang po, Madam Chair, Mr. Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: yung pinatayo po natin doon na structure para doon sa Philippine Coast Guard,

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: yun po ay natapos na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, the Philippine Coast Guard are planning to medyo magamit na po nila yun

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: sa siguro ito, isang bagay ito na makakatulong po doon sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: ...Lorana Station po doon sa barangadong po sa munisipalidad po ng Bagamanok.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Madam Secretary, ay Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, ang kasi requirements ng Coast Guard, iba po sa amin.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Mas malaki po yung kailangan namin at mas malalaki po ang mga barko na pumapasok.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ang report sa akin po ng FOIC, maraming claimants doon sa area.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ang alawa po, ang pinakamalaking problema, nakita naman po natin kanina,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: yung capital outlay budget natin binawasan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, paano po tayo magproceed kung gano'n?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Bagamat gano'n, baka magtulungan na lang po kami sa Coast Guard.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Pag-usapan na lang po namin kung paano kami makapagtulungan sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Based on yung capabilities namin na makakapasok sa mainland po ng Bicol.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, yung ano naman po, Madam Chair, yung sa lupa naman po doon, alam ko naman na okay naman po, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Philippine Coast Guard.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Alam naman tayong problema doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Anyway, thank you po, Madam Secretary, Madam Chair and Mr. Secretary, sa napawaganda mong kasagutan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Alam ko naman na hindi mo papabaya ng katanduanis dahil isa yun po sa talagang dapat protektan din naman natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Dahil nandoon nga kami sa, ikang malapit kami sa Binham Rice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Eulogio "Leo" R. Rodriguez
segments.text: Salamat po. Salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Kong Leo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Next to interpolate from the minority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Representative Elijah San Fernando.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, good morning po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: It is the duty of the state to protect its citizens at all times.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ito po ang state policy natin, Mr. Secretary. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Oh, yeah.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, to protect effectively, ang ibig sabihin po nito, our men in uniform must be well-equipped and well-rationed po, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And being well-equipped and well-rationed.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, means being able to provide for our own.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Tama po, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Not necessarily, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We provide in several ways.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Of course, that's part of resilience.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But the reality of the situation is worldwide.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: There are defined supply chains for specific items of need.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We should provide for our own when we can.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Now, in the PDP midterm update,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, the Philippine Development Plan is the plan upon which all plans of all departments must be anchored upon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: In Chapter 13.1, Outcome No. 4, it says that one of the outcome indicators is to develop a modern, credible, self-reliant defense force.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, can you discuss what is the operational definition of self-reliance?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It is to secure your supply chains for the most expeditious and cost-effective means possible.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We know it cannot be totally indigenous.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Self-reliance does not mean indigenous.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It means securing your supply chains on the most favorable of terms and at the least lead time possible.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, it doesn't necessarily mean, Mr. Secretary, na tayo lang.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, as much as possible, if we can acquire it.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's called import substitution already, which is different from self-reliance.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Because, I mean, as I made an example earlier, there was a program during the 70s, although it was cut short,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: where, knowing fully well, there was a lack of grazing land in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It would be cheaper to buy land in other countries.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Which were...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Lightly populated, grow the cattle there for the Philippine cattle industry.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, although the activity is somewhere else, the beneficiary being in this country, that is a way of resilience too.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, for us, it's to get what we need at the speediest possible time and on an evolutionary basis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary. I'll get back to that point po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Now, in your NEP po, Mr. Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: dito po sa government arsenal, nabawasan po ng 21.8% yung budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Can you enlighten the committee as to why the budget for government arsenal was reduced by 21.8%?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Capital outlay, Your Honor, for structures and facilities.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And we already have a new roadmap for the government arsenal.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It being a sovereign enterprise, just like the Philippine mint.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Central bank mint.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And so, the future activity will be to concentrate not on small arms but on something else.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: On the first quarter target po, or output, ang nakasulat po dito sa 2026 target is we need to produce 60 million rounds of ammunition.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: The actual output is only...

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Can you enlighten the committee as to bakit po ganito kababa?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's the market sourcing for precursors, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It is a worldwide shortage right now.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's a supplier's market.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, where do we usually get these precursors, Mr. Secretary?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Depends, Your Honor, on the availability.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We can get from the United States, we can get from South Africa, we can get from Brazil and other countries, which are very few.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Because these are nitrocellulose.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it's a seller's market.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Dito po sa Rule 4, Section 1F ng SRDP Revitalization Act,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: any foreign procurement must include a mandatory understudy program to train Filipino workers and secure technology transfer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Of the multi-billion peso contracts in the 2027 program of DND,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ilan po dito yung mga contract na merong audited, binding, understudy programs and tech transfer clauses?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: There are no new 2027 contracts except very few, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And as I said earlier, that law is unworkable unless you spend for R&D and for...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ah...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Equity in order to have a share of the intellectual property rights.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: You have to invest on the risk side, on the R&D side to benefit from the upside.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Or else you'll not get any viable self-reliance program whatsoever.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Because the most important thing is you share in the intellectual property rights.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's the crown jewel of everything.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Madam Chair, kaya ko po

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Tinanong itong mga tanong ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Because it is in my position that defense also has something to do with industrial policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: For us to be able to defend ourselves and for us to have an effective defense plan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: we must have an industrial policy.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Definitely, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it means that being able to produce for our own, being able to equip our own.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Now, Mr. Secretary, what is your comment about the statement of...

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ...Secretary Arsenio Balisacan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Wherein he said that we do not need to do or we don't have to do industrial policy like what our neighbors did.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And this is in line with the PDP, the Philippine Development Plan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: wherein one of the outcome indicators says that we must develop our self-reliant defense force.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, probably what he means is that you don't need to reinvent the wheel

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: if you can get the technology.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But there are some immutables, that there are some basics that you need to remediate.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ease of doing business, transaction costs, administrative costs, connectivity and power.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Unless you lower these costs, then any industrial activity is a value proposition

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: that must have a positive outcome indicator.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: If not, it will be a sunk cost that will be marginal for any country.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Unless it's a public good.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That, for example, a railroad, which doesn't make money.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, maybe the statement of Secretary Balisacan is that it's useless to reinvent things

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: that we can have with partnerships or with sustainable like-minded...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: ...co-venturing and place what you can value-add based on your own characteristics to the initiative.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But nonetheless, there is no input without an output.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: As you can see, I'm a supporter of industrial policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: I definitely support it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: All of the problems that we are facing now, like high electricity costs, etc.,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: hinarap din po kasi ito ng mga problema ng mga kapitbahay natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: We have South Korea, we have Taiwan, we have Vietnam, even China, say, for example.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: But their economic managers have that ambition to really develop their industries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: My point here, Madam Chair and Mr. Secretary, again, for us to have an effective defense plan

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: and for us to really do what is written in the Constitution

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: to protect our people at all times,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: industrial policy is a must so that in times of war, say, for example,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: or nagkaroon naman mga challenging times,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: kung hindi man makapag-provide yung mga pinagkukunan natin ng mga precursors, materials, etc.,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: at least we can say that we can provide for our own and we can equip our men in uniform.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Totally agree, Your Honor. There's no debate about it. I totally agree.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary, for agreeing with me. Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Kong Eli San Fernando.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Next to interpolate, Congressman Ahong Chan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Madam Chair, thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Good afternoon to our good Secretary, DND family, and to my colleagues.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Good afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Lapu-Lapu City hosts two major AFP facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: The Philippine Air Force Base and the Philippine Navy Base.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: We are proud and fortunate to have these military facilities in our city.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: As representative of the Lone District of Lapu-Lapu City,

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: I have consistently supported their infrastructure projects and development programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: However, there is an ongoing illegal reclamation activity inside the Philippine Navy area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: It has no clearance from the Lapu-Lapu City government, no permit from the Philippine

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Reclamation Authority, and no permit or environmental clearance from the DENR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Therefore, this is clearly an illegal reclamation. Before this reclamation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: the area was part of the sea and served as a natural waterway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: But because this portion of the sea has been filled up, the natural flow of water has been blocked,

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: causing flooding in the neighboring barangays. We must also consider that Lapu-Lapu City

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: is a small island with very limited land. Any major development or reclamation, especially

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: one undertaken illegally and without coordination, can seriously affect the entire city master plan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: including the land use, drainage, infrastructure, environmental protection,

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: and future development.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, this illegal reclamation is already affecting the overall development of Lapu-Lapu City

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: and the implementation of our city master plan. That is why I respectfully request

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: that the DND, the office of the representative of the Lone District of Lapu-Lapu City,

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: and the Lapu-Lapu City Government sit down immediately to discuss and resolve this matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: We fully support the AFP, but all developments must be properly coordinated

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: and harmonized with the City Master Plan for the protection of our people

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: and the sustainable development of our small island city.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Secretary and Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, we'll make an internal study and see what's appropriate

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: insofar as we are concerned and so far as presidential guidance is concerned regarding military lands.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's all I can say for now, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: But, Mr. Secretary, we know that this is under presidential

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: proclamation, but what I'm telling is the illegal reclamation, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, if in case of legality or illegality, I'll refer you to the other departments

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: with consultation with us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: So that we can have this, I mean, smooth for the development

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: that the Master Plan of the City will not affect, especially for the outfall

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: of our drainage, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: If it is a matter of drainage, Your Honor, that I can tell the affected agencies

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: to look into it.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: However, the, as I see, there is a pending case also over the proclaimed area.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We're talking about the same thing.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And I have to make an internal...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Consultation with the different cabinet agencies to see what we can do before we can give a

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: definitive commitment or answer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, for your information, this is different from the pending case, what I'm

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: raising right now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: What I'm raising right now is the illegal reclamation along the sea.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: The pending case is different.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: This is in the entrance side.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: So, I am not...

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Talking about the...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I will have to make an internal inquiry about it and we'll have to see what we do.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: I hope that you can give us, the Mayor, can we present to you in your office what really

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: happening inside the Naval...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, I'll have to consult again based on our operational security mandates and then

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: we will determine what the best course of action is.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Rest assured.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: You have voiced your concerns and I take note of them, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary.
