segments.text: It also goes without saying that he is our pride of the U.P. College of Law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Having number one in the bar examinations, I was only number 17.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, I have to bring this list by the Taliba who were in the top 20

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: because nobody believes if you are number 11 to 20.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: But no doubt that Secretary Gilbert,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Secretary Teodoro, number one in the bar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, I have a question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Number one is, what is the budget of the DND for the Lumbia 15th Strike Wing?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: If that is right, yeah.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: What is now the budget for 2027 to further develop our Lumbia EDCA site?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, I beg a few seconds to retrieve the data.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: In the facilities, for this year, Your Honor, it's 115 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: But again, for this year, 2026?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yeah, yeah, 115.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Million?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor, that's the remaining.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And for next year?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's the remaining, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Completed?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Yes, thank you. 115 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, there's already a budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Save enhancements that may be done.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And what is now also the counterpart of the United States Government? Being an EDCA site?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Not yet, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I thought as EDCA site,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: there will already be infusion of American dollars to further develop that Lumbia airport.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, the development of, even for us, for the 15th Strike Wing,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and to have a maintenance base.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Maintenance base. They're hampered by right-of-way issues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: What is the problem?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Informal settlers,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, that has hampered us.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it's only now that we have

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: taken the appropriate

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: legal proceedings and

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: working towards looking for

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: adequate relocation for us

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: to fully utilize,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: not only for the 15th Strike Wing,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: but it shall serve as the

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Northern Mindanao Operations Center for the OCD.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: There are still illegal settlers

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and the access road to the highway,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, to the highway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Gibo. Now, in the

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: master plan, what is the contribution of

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: the United States Government

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: to the Lumbia Airport?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: They are still scoping, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: what they can do with the area, particularly knowing that

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: again, Cagayan de Oro is

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: vulnerable to mudslides.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And since it will be also a

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: coordination center

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: for Northern Mindanao for HADR,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: they're scoping in those

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: lines, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: They're scoping,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: The scoping is for a multipurpose warehouse, and for us,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, it's air traffic control enhancement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, in the plan, what is the structures

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: to be built by the U.S.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Government?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So far, there's nothing agreed,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor. They're scoping for a warehouse.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Warehouse.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: There will be social costs when the Americans would go there.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: What are the plans of our Armed Forces of the Philippines and the DND?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: On social costs,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, that's why the right-of-way issues

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: will be the first.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And the

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: relocation issues

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: will be the most important thing, which we are

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: addressing, because we need to address

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: it in order to provide base security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Referring to, you know, when there are Americans,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: you know, there will be prostitution.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, there will be...

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Any plans for that to protect?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: our women in Cagayan de Oro.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: No, they will be guided by SOFA, Your Honor, if ever they are there, present, you know, and...

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The SOFA will provide for how do we protect our women of Cagayan de Oro.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor, in the same way as they should be protected

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: from our own exploitation by our own men, too.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Next question is, how is now the proposed naval base in our neighboring town of Tagoloan?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That will be the dockyard, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's still awaiting finalization of the titling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The titling?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Is that in the PHIVIDEC area, Honorable Secretary?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It is the southern...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It is in the southern portion of the PHIVIDEC area, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: How much will that entail in cost

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: once the titling is already done?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: For a complete dry dock.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, that will be able to support our fleet, growing fleet.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's about 40 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: How much, Secretary?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Forty. Forty billion, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Ah, the cost of the dry dock is 40 billion?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Indeed.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: The whole thing, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Whole thing?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Together with equipment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Indeed, that will bring forth substantial economic activity for Cagayan de Oro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you very much for that, Secretary.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: From there.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's strategic because it can be a dry dock

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: because it's relatively free from typhoons.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it can accommodate even the largest vessel, which is an LPD.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But because the Subic Naval Base right now is...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We cannot use it as a dry dock.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's an operating naval base.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: This one will be adopted.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It is a real dry dock where we can adequately maintain and supervise all our vessels.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, thank you for thinking of relocating it in Misamis Oriental, in Tagoloan, which is beside the city of Cagayan de Oro, the city of golden friendship.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, we thank you for that, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And when will the title be?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: What is the timetable?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Of course, you have lawyers and the title would be finished about when.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And when will the start of the construction be?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We're awaiting that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: For Cagayan de Oro and Misamis Oriental.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, I await too.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And we're trying our level best to get the titling done.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Because we need to leave, vacate Sangley as soon as possible

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: because it is extremely shallow, extremely small.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it's getting to be unmaneuverable for our naval platforms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: That is good news to Mindanao, specifically Northern Mindanao and entire Mindanao, and Cagayan de Oro and Misamis Oriental.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: My other question, Mr. Secretary, is before there were talks about the transfer of the 4th military area which we oppose,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: are there still plans to transfer the 4th Infantry Division in Cagayan de Oro, Patag, to another place?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That is not a specific guidance, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Our specific guidance is for the Army to relocate.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: To scope their areas where they need to have the homes

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Of their divisions and brigades.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: With respect to having a division headquarters or a brigade headquarters as a connectivity node,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: as a logistical supply point, as a motor pool,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and for divisions to contain medical facilities adequately to support.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And this must be able to...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Provide connectivity to strategic bases of other services.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: If not, then the strategic bases...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: bases cannot be resupplied adequately, so it is a whole exercise in logistics, Your Honor, and I know

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: there are certain legacy areas which first have developed massive roots already and we will keep

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: this into consideration nonetheless the exercise really is in logistics your honor because we have

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: a very very big difficulty particularly in humanitarian assistance and disaster response

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and resupplying our own troops it's quite difficult so we need to have the logistics

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: capabilities in order for the armed forces to pursue its uh external defense role thank you

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Secretary, you know, Patag

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: for the division is really very, very strategically located. Of course, Cagayan de Oro is the gateway to

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Mindanao. If we talk about Davao, you go around the Zamboanga Peninsula, and so in

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: terms of logistics that's the best side and I believe that there is still uh area that will

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: be used for that. So we ask you on behalf of the city of Cagayan de Oro to consider that as the

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: continuing

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: area for the Armed Forces because it is very strategically located. From Cagayan de Oro, you

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: go to Bukidnon, and then you go to Butuan. So please consider that, Mr. Secretary, because we would wish

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: that to remain in the city of Cagayan de Oro. On the three domains—

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, and the fourth domain, the cyber domain and the IT domain, that is indeed a valuable

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: position, and as a matter of fact we are adding on the naval domain with the dockyard that is

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: proposed, and Lumbia as the home of the 15th Strike Wing where they will train and they will

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: maintain, and it will also be the home of the Northern Mindanao Operations Center

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: of the OCD.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, Your Honor, rest assured that that is an area of prime consideration for us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary Gibo. It now looks that, uh, the Secretary is looking at Cagayan de Oro and Misamis Oriental. We have the 15th Strike Wing

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: in Lumbia, and then we have the dockyard, 40 billion, in

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: in the municipality, and then our Army is there in Patag to be enlarged to become a logistical

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: center because Cagayan de Oro is the center of Northern Mindanao and gateway to entire Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, with that we thank the Secretary for the Lumbia airport, we thank the Secretary for the dockyard,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: and we thank the Secretary for enlarging the 4th Infantry Division. Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Again, we thank you for your service to this nation, which is unequaled in recent history.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Vice Chair Rufus Rodriguez. Given that there are no other minority members who are listed for the first round, we will proceed

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: with the majority members.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, from the majority, the next to interpolate, Rep. Marlo Bancoro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Good afternoon, my dear colleagues. Good afternoon, Secretary Gibo and the DND family. Mine is just a

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: parochial concern, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: My proposal is a

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: joint camp with the PNP, Army, and Coast Guard,

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: and the

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: previous Chief of Staff [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: It will be implemented by the local government unit of [unclear], where the island is situated

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: and on which the camp is going to be constructed. So my concern

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: is the request of the regional director [unclear] the PNP [unclear]

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: the council of the PNP [unclear], the Coast Guard, and the commission for the Coast Guard [unclear]

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: of the MOA for the downloading of the funds, and the PNP supposedly by August 27 also. Unfortunately, it's

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: scheduled [unclear] for the budget hearing. [Unclear] PNP authority

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Now, sir, it is on the part of the Armed Forces. Batay kung doon sa

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: guidance namin and ini-re-scope ng lahat ng AFP units ang kanilang areas of operation

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: based on logistics requirements namin.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Uh, [unclear].

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Uh, now, given the parochial concern, anyway...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, based on the guidance that we gave to them because I don't want to divert

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: the attention to the major logistical needs of the Armed Forces that we really need to pay attention to

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: because even the resupply of the base that you will do will be affected if you don't start with

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: our major logistical bases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Marlo C. Bancoro
segments.text: Uh, Madam Chair, may I approach them to discuss? Anyway, this is just one minute.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Cong., thank you. Thank you. Meeting suspended.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Okay, next to interpolate, Vice Chair Anna York Bondoc. Vice Chair Anna York Bondoc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you so much.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Okay na. Magandang hapon po, Mr. Secretary and the DND family. Thank you so much for the opportunity for us to be able to work closely with you and support your 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: First of all, I would like to greet our new AFP Chief of Staff.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Nag-meet po kami for the first time and I had the pleasure of meeting him for the first time last year in Bongabon, Nueva Ecija

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: with the 703rd Agila Brigade.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: At nagkita po kami because I wanted to express my support and thanks po to the 7th Infantry Division last year

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: and the brigade and the battalion [unclear] sa baha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, I thought last year was the worst thing that ever happened to me.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Ayun pala, this year it was going to be worse. So, I have a few pictures in case you're interested po to see.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Up to today po, I come from the 4th District of Pampanga, which is the catch basin po, lahat po ng tubig from Aurora.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Ayan po si Kong Angara. Yung tubig niyo bumabagsak sa amin. Yung buong Nueva Ecija po. buong province of Bulacan, and even the Sierra Madre Mountains. So the amount of water pouring in is truly tremendous.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So ayan po ang tumutulong po sa amin. Pakita ninyo iyong baha mismo, iyong plaza po namin iyan. So yan, and that is, later on I will speak to you about MacArthur Highway. So it was actually a good thing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: I had never worked with the Philippine Army previous to last year and I was very grateful sa kanila pong efficiency

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: and ang bilis po nilang kumilos and most of all their compassion towards us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So from someone who previously didn't know much about the Army, it was really a revelation to me.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, ang maganda po from what happened last year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: I am of the philosophy that kung kumikilos ka, pag may baha, huli ka na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: In other words, it is better to prepare for a disaster rather than, even though ang dami hung tumulong, mali pa po yun and that we need to prepare.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, I would like to again commend,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And nagkaroon po kami ng malawakang Bantay Sapa, or the largest coastal cleanup of Manila Bay. Hindi po makalabas

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: yung tubig sa amin because of siltation po sa mga sapa. So this last

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: June, ako po ang nagpondo, lahat po ng tupad ko, pinondohan namin more than 1,500 tupad members.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Last [unclear] slide, please. More than 1,500 tupad members po joined us dun sa Bantay Sapa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: This is already the third year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So we have been doing this for the last three years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Hindi po kami kumikilos dahil may baha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Kumikilos po kami bago po magkabaha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So you can see this is the Philippine Army, the Philippine Coast Guard, and the Philippine Navy with the DENR and the local government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So nagkaroon po kami ng Memorandum of Understanding. And I would like to thank Philippine Army,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Philippine Navy, ayan po, Coast Guard, at lahat po ng tumulong sa amin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So year one, we were able to clear 9,000 basura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Year two, 17,000. And year three, 15,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So despite all of that, binaha pa rin po kami this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So I would personally like to thank, again, I would like to personally mention

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: [unclear], General Osias, and our battalion commander,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: si Lieutenant Colonel [unclear], for their kindness po this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Hindi lang po sila kind, they are very efficient at mabilis pong kumilos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, Secretary, pinupugayan po namin sila sa kanila pong kasipagan at kabaitan sa amin. So, wala po akong masyadong tanong. I would just like to thank them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: I would also like to mention an incident po nang nangyari. One of the ways to prevent flood po is through dredging.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: and palabas po yung tubig namin sa Manila Bay. And personally po, nagka-problema na rin po pala ang Philippine Navy sa Manila Bay

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: because of the siltation. So tinulungan po namin sila and we were very happy to work with them

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: to dredge po, grabe na po ang siltation, pati po ang Philippine Navy tinamaan na rin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And we had to dredge together yung pagdating po ng kanilang destroyer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So upon conversation po with former Commodore, now present Admiral, tama po ba ako Admiral Nera

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: nagkausap po kami and nalaman po namin and I told him that if Manila [unclear] silted, and if our destroyers, and we are modernizing the Navy, at mas malalim pa

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: siguro yung kailangan po nating volume of tubig, tama po ba ako?

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, therefore, dredgers are a very important component po, and very much badly needed by our Navy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, Sec, nagka-intindihan po kami that the Philippine Navy needs to purchase dredgers. Kasi po, I told them,

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: if we are going to purchase large ships, kailangan po talaga ng dredgers. So, I hope you could support the much-needed dredgers po ng Philippine Navy.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Of course, Madam Chair, because we really need it also for our own naval bases and ports. There's one in the pipeline

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: right now, coming in.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Opo. Actually, medyo nagkaagawan nga po ng dredger. Kasi we need naman to dredge sa Manila Bay. Kasi babahain kami. But we gladly lent our dredger po to the Philippine Navy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So tinanong po sa akin [unclear] kataas yung dredger na kailangan. And then they said 1991 pa daw yung pinag-agawan namin. So

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: it would be really a good idea. May isang suggestion po ako

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: na madali. Lahat po ng nase-seize na illegal dredgers lagyan ninyo ng exception sa Tariff and Customs code na imbis na isubasta iyan, dalhin na lang sa Coast Guard at saka sa Navy lahat ng [unclear] ng mga dredgers para magamit ho natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: Kasi kailangan isubasta eh under the Tariff and Customs Code.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So minsan, kapag nakaka-seize ng vessels na malalaki, sinusubasta ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: And then, nariregurgitate o narirecycle.

segments.speaker: Rep. Anna York P. Bondoc, M.D.
segments.text: So, kung puwede, [unclear] na lang ho iyan, lalo na pag kailangan ng Navy o ng Coast Guard or ng DENR, for example. Depending on the size, na illegal na mga vessels na imbis na mandatory na isubasta, i-turnover po kung magagamit. Mas [unclear], malaking tulong din po sa atin iyan. Thank you po. And sana po masuportahan niyo po yung purchase of dredgers kasi kailangan po ng Navy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Okay, thank you so much po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Vice Chair Anna York Bondoc.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Next to interpellate, Congressman Jay Vergara.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Thank you, Chair. Magandang tanghali po sa [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: At susugan ko lang po yung sinabi ni Congresswoman Ana. Regional problem mo yung pinag-uusapan. Dahil minalas tayo ng ating mga bundok ay hinayaan nating kalbuhin na tayo rin ang may kasalanan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Sakit ho ng konti kung Jay, kalbuhin. Medyo bawasan ng tira, tatamaan po kayo.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Medyo malapit na rin doon, eh. Malapit na, eh. Kaya medyo kayo, nangingitim pa pati bigote, tinutubuan. Kanina pa ho ninyo akong niloloko roon sa bigote ko, eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Hindi ko po niloloko; nangingitim lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Anyway po, ang pinakamataas po na peak ay si General Pasamonte at si General Osias ay mga kaibigan ko rin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Ang pinakamataas na peak doon sa amin sa Nueva Ecija po, ang pangalan po ay Paatas Peak sa Mount Kimalugong. Para po maintindihan po ng lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Sa Mount Kemalugong, ito po ay parte ng Sierra Madre.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Bago dumating ng Caraballo, tapos didiretso sa Cordillera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: So ang dahilan po ng pagbaha ay zero meters above sea level dito sa Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Alin po ba ang zero meter above sea level?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Ang zero meter po ay Manila Bay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Kaya po yun ang katotohanan kung bakit talaga binabaha tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Ano ho?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Yung bulubundukin na pagka ho may problema ng konti, dire diretsyo yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Pagka naligo ka, dire-diretsyo yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: [unclear] sa Paatas Peak, it's 1,750 meters above sea level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: At ang pinagsusukatan po ng Metro Manila ay Manila Bay, which is zero meter above sea level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Para ho siyang Luneta na doon nagsisimula yung zero nung kilometrahe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Ano po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: So, pinag-aralan po namin mabuti yung distrito namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Mula sa Bongabon, sa Gabaldon, sa Laur, sa Natividad, sa Palayan, at sa Cabanatuan City po. Tutuloy po ito ng Santa Rosa. Tutuloy po ito sa dalawang river.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Sa gawi po ng 4th District of Nueva Ecija, yung po ay Peñaranda–Rio Chico River.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Pero pupunta rin po siya sa Pampanga River.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Kaya iiyak po talaga yung taga-Pampanga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Yung pong distrito ng ating chairwoman sa appropriations, kay Chairwoman Mika, yung po ay sa Bongabon maghihiwalay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Yung sa Talavera River, yung papunta naman po sa amin sa Cabanatuan, sa Cabanatuan bababa. Pero pagka pinag-aralan ninyong mabuti, diretsyo rin po siya doon sa Pampanga River.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Babahain ang sampung bayan ng Tarlac. Babahain ang sampung bayan ng Pampanga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Pagkatapos, di diretsyong sigurado sa Bulacan at hahanap kasi ng level sa Manila Bay na kung sa naroon ang zero meter above sea level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: So, sinusugan ko lamang po kay Kong Ana yung kanya pong sinasabi para po maintindihan rin po ninyo. Alam ko po yung posisyon ng Department of National Defense hinggil po doon sa ating Fort Magsaysay area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Pero yung concern po ng Gabaldon, ng Dingalan, nila Kong Rommel Angara po, yung concern po ng Bongabon, Gabaldon, Laur, Santa Rosa, Cabanatuan City...

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Hindi po kasama ang Natividad, Peñaranda, at saka General Tinio, ay yung pong 44,341.637 hectares na kasama po sa Fort Magsaysay Reserve.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: So, ako po ay siguro ako na po ang huling magsalita. Kung may sususog pa po sa akin, ako po ay sumusuporta lamang po sa inyong pagtulong sa amin parati.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Ang akin lamang po ay hilingin ko lang na makausap po namin, Secretary, kung sino po talaga ang magiging representative ng Department of Defense o ng Army hinggil dito sa usaping ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julius Cesar "Jay" V. Vergara
segments.text: Kasi ang pupunta po sa mga mayor namin sa Palayan, sa Gabaldon, sa General Tinio, sa Laur, sa Peñaranda, sa Santa Rosa, sa Dingalan, at saka sa Cabanatuan ay hindi po nagpupunta yung inyong mismong tao para mapag-usapan po nang maayos itong usapin na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Kong Jay.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Dahil na-realize ko yung concern, really, sa Fort Magsaysay na kailangan ng Armed Forces ngayon, pero ito'y kailangan din sa connectivity ng dalawang lalawigan. At may flood-control implications na kailangan solbahin natin lahat, kasi hindi rin naman puwedeng mabaha yung area o pagdaluyan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Hinggil dito, humingi lang ako ng paumanin sapagkat nagkulang kami ng tao kaya nga po ni-raise natin ang isang opisina dun sa real estate management sa DND level na USEC para makabuild ng ecosystem si dating Assistant Secretary Ramos.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Inangat po natin na USEC kasi yung real estate management nagiging malaking... ...issue na kailangan harapin.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ganun po, ganun man din, ang talagang point person dito ay dapat yung installation and management command ng Philippine Army.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Kung sino ang nagsusupervise dito.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, hiling ko muna sa IMCOM within the week, can you establish base with Congressman Vergara? And Congressman Angara.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And can you create the flow mechanism to try to solve the issue?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: If the issue is really flood control, I will raise it up to DPWH or whatever agency.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But at least there must be a flow already because until we are able to support and staff under Secretary Ramos' team... ...to support him, kulang na kulang kami talaga.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Nandiyan ba si Eman? Wala.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ah, naka-leave. Naka-leave. Naka-leave. But siya po ay nagpapahinga lang dahil talagang kawawa rin yung tao. We have about live real estate issues, mga halos tatlong daan. Tapos 40,000 ba yung dine-defend natin, na-ejectment cases, so forth and so on.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, pati OSG po nagre-reklamo na doon sa amin. Ngunit, ito na po ang aking [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Within the week, can you ask your IMCOM to meet with Congressman Vergara and Congressman Angara? And submit to me monthly progress reports on the issues and what happens. Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Madam Chair, can I interject with the Congressman?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Thank you. Maraming salamat po. First and foremost, maraming maraming salamat po, Secretary Gibo Teodoro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Before I begin, ako po ay nagpapasalamat sa ating Armed Forces of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: In fact, kami po sa lalawigan ng Aurora, sa Lone District of Aurora, kami ata yung unang nag-build ng buong buo yung ating camp ng ating Armed Forces of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Gusto ko lang pong dagdagan yung sinabi ni Congressman Jay Vergara na binanggit po niya dun sa ating military reservation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Yes. We've known for a fact that ito po ay pagmamay-ari ng ating base militar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: But earlier, hindi ko po alam na magsasalita si Congressman Jay because I was supposed to go to the other committee hearing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: But I approached USEC Gavin, which was given to me by our Chair Bella.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Ang aking hiling lang po is because for the past 47 years, ang aming probinsya po, ang lalawigan ng Aurora, before ay maraming insurgents. But now, halos nawala na po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: My fear, Mr. Secretary, is that because of the ongoing military reservation on the ground level, yung kaninang sinasabi ni Congressman Jay Vergara na nagko-coordinate directly to the mayors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Siguro po, a bit of thought, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Sorry. Siguro kami naman po ay willing makipagtulungan sa ating Armed Forces of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: In fact, ang sabi ko po kay Yusek Gavin kanina, I think there's a proper way on how to do it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: In fact, like for example sa Aurora po, if I'm not mistaken, there's around 6,000-plus hectares sa military reservation sa tatlo o apat na barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: And this comprises around 3,000 families na madi-displace.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Pero pag sabi ko, ako, I've always been optimistic on how government works.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Sabi ko, pag nagtulungan naman ang LGU, myself, the Department of Defense, even the Office of the President, I think there is a right way or procedure on how to do things.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Kasi po, I'll be honest with you, Mr. Secretary, may mga bahay na pong nandoon po talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: So, on our part, as the government, it will be difficult na paalisin sila ng ura-urada.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: And hindi naman po tama rin iyon. You've also been a district representative, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: So, tayo yung takbuhan ng ating mga kababayan, even the mayor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: So ako po, maraming salamat na sinabi po ninyo na magtatalaga agad kayo ng isang USEC na kakausap sa aming tatlong congressman sa military reservation in Nueva Ecija and Aurora, namely Congressman Jay Vergara, Congressman Emeng Pascual, and for me, the Lone District of the Province of Aurora.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Mas maganda po sana na upuan po ito natin. And I think pag inupuan po ng mga leaders po iyan, together with your USEC, undersecretaries, and the people concerned, ay ito po ay mapag-uusapan nang maayos at puwede pa tayong magtulungan moving forward, Mr. Secretary. Iyon lamang po, Mr. Secretary. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ito po sa Aurora na pinagtutuunan namin ng pansin. Number one is the boundary between Quezon and Aurora and Rizal, na ang Army ay manipis doon sa area na iyon, pati po Infanta.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly is the foreshore area na importante po sa amin, lalo na sa Dingalan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So kailangan din siguro, on the naval side, Admiral Ezpeleta, tutukan mo ng tao rin kasama ng IMCOM.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Okay. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Vice Chair Rommel Angara and Congressman Jay Vergara.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Last to interpellate for the first round, from the majority, Representative Jeffrey Ferrer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jeffrey P. Ferrer
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jeffrey P. Ferrer
segments.text: Alam ko, exhausted na si Secretary. So kaninang umaga pa to.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jeffrey P. Ferrer
segments.text: Pero sandali lang to the AFP family. Good afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jeffrey P. Ferrer
segments.text: E tanong ko lang, how is peace and order in Negros Island, Secretary?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Well, for now, we are seeing some stability in Negros Island.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And we are thankful to the local government for the support of the whole province of Negros Occidental.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: For the support for national security.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That being said, on the oriental side, the situation remains stable also.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So we are also likewise thankful for the all-out support of the local government.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And the convergence between the local government.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And the armed forces of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Particularly, when we view the situation that Negros, with the continuous degassing of Mount Canlaon,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: needs a different kind of attention right now.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Where we face severe relocation issues that we need to do.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And we are still rebuilding lives.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So we cannot afford any peace and order disruptions in the area at this time.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jeffrey P. Ferrer
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jeffrey P. Ferrer
segments.text: Alam mo naman po, in the past months, tinamaan tayo ng Bagyong Tino doon.

segments.text: Kamusta yung, is there an ongoing project or rehabilitation sa mga areas na na-damage ng Bagyong Tino?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Sa rehabilitation, nagkaroon sila ng Negros ay yung Canlaon Rehabilitation Plan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But it lacks sufficient detail for me.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Kaya sinuli ko muna sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And the most important thing on the Canlaon issue is the acquisition of land for relocation.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: In areas which are not affected.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And I think they identified some areas on the...

segments.text: Doon sa 4th,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: doon sa rehabilitation,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: ito ay hindi na nanggagaling sa amin,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: nanggagaling sa mother agencies,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: batay sa kautosan ng DBM.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Nonetheless,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: OCD-NIR

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: is tasked to continuously coordinate

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.

segments.text: For example, with Congresswoman Ana Bondoc,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Thank you very much, Secretary.

segments.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

segments.text: Thank you, Chair. Actually, it's not an interpolation

segments.text: but more of a

segments.text: giving my

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: trust and confidence

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: to the Secretary

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: for doing a good job,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: especially the AFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: And good afternoon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Sir Gilbert

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: and your Chief of Staff

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: whom we've

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: confirmed in the CA recently.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: And congratulations

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: to my cousin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Lieutenant General Donald Gumiran for... [unclear]. But more than anything, Secretary, I talked to your Chief of Staff, si Toto, General Toto, who was asking

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: How we can strengthen your engineering brigade, because if you remember history, Europe and even Asia was built by the Marshall Plan. And if you have a strong engineering brigade that you have there, and we can add budgets, then you will be more receptive not only to help in disaster mitigation, especially in cases where flooding is there, but more so during...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: the non-delicate seasons

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: where there's no typhoon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: we can use the engineers

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: to actually rehabilitate

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: a lot of areas

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: in the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: especially a particular

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: airline like what you did

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: in Mindalao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: So, I'd just like to ask, Secretary, if you'd be able to help us create some type of Marshall Plan for your engineering brigade.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Is that feasible or not?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Actually, our engineering brigades are converting into combat engineering brigades,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: which are there to allow our equipment to work safely and sustainably.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: For example, the emergency bridging that will support our heavy equipment.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly, it will be the demining or equipment.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Which are engineers.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly, if we have them, they should be devoted to base development and not contracted out anymore for civil engineering services.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, actually, what has happened is we were devoting civil engineering equipment to non-AFP matters.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And our base...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Base development suffered.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, one thing led to another.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly, also, I understand the need for civil engineering, which is why the Army's game plan right now is to increase its footprint in areas which may be unoccupied.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And the first thing you need to do is access.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And the access to the base...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: whether it be a division headquarters or a brigade headquarters, will be an all-weather, heavy-duty road access,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: which will benefit the economy.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it will be a connectivity node.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it will allow resupply, and it will allow presence and deterrence at the same time,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: whether it be for deforestation, illegal mining, or what have you.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, uh...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We have that as a strategic plan because we need to increase the Army's footprint,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and we need strategic basing that will be resupplied by the nodes created on the baselines.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's part of the integrated defense concept, which will, in turn, benefit the economy because of the all-weather access.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: But in terms of disaster,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: I'm sure you're always there because you're head of the NDRMC, if I remember.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: So, like, yung mga basura na nangyayari dito, it's a man-made thing in Metro Manila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: and sometimes the government is being blamed for not implementing flood controls.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: I'm sure with your help, Secretary, we will hopefully give enough budgets for your engineering brigade to help in that natural disaster, at least.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Because we are the number one prone disaster country in the whole world.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And, yes, yes, Your Honor, we totally agree.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: And lastly, Madam Chair, we talked also in the Commission on Appointments about the drone program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: which, of course, it is highly sensitive, and the Chief of Staff has not really given us...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Well, you're supposed to report to us the progress of the drones.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Because, as you can understand,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: a small country like Ukraine now can actually fight a superpower like Russia and beat them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: And if you remember, Secretary, we once talked about this two years ago,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: and I told you that drone technology is the best way we won't lose anything.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: And during armed conflicts, you can send it into critical areas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: So, I'd like lang the status of this, and I'm in full support.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We're building the framework and the backbone for it.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's all I can disclose now.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And, you know, as I said, the drones themselves are easy to do.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's what you put in them, depending on the purpose that we are.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And these are not autonomous devices [unclear], right?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, we are developing the control systems for it alongside the capabilities.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We do have capabilities [unclear].

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And that is well within the engagement framework of the Armed Forces of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's all I can disclose.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Thank you, thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: With that, Madam Chairman, this representation is in full support of the Filipino Army and, of course, the DND.

segments.text: Kayo po ang heroes ng Pilipino.

segments.text: Nakakatulog po kami ng mahingbing dahil sa servisyo na inaalay niyo yung sarili niyong buhay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Para sa kapakanan ng ating bansa at mga mamayang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Kaya saludo po kami at full support po ang House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Lalo na tinapunta po ako ni Speaker Boji dito para sabihin po sa inyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: full support po ang opisina ni Speaker at ang mga congressman dito po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Gusto ko rin pong kunin itong pagkakataon na ito na batiin ang ating mabuting kaibigan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Sa kanyang recent na estado sa buhay, finally, siya ay malapit na mag-sixty.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Isang taon lang yan.

segments.text: Sixty na pala siya dahil ako ay sixty-two na.

segments.text: Nagdesisyon na rin lumagay sa tahimik.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Hindi ko lang alam yung agwat nung dalawa.

segments.text: Mr. Secretary, 32 years.

segments.text: Mas matanda pa ako sa tatay at nanay nung pinakasalan kong Amerikano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Kaya meron pa lang.

segments.text: Pag-asa ang pagmamahal kahit na papalo.

segments.text: [unclear].

segments.text: And we really, as a personal friend, I congratulate you, Representative Tony P.

segments.text: Thank you, Secretary.

segments.text: I will tell Nicky, [unclear].

segments.text: We cannot disclose that, Your Honor.

segments.text: It's operationally secure.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: All we can say is that so far as we are concerned, the operation was legitimately conducted.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
