segments.text: And this was noted in a police blotter of the PNP as well as acknowledged by the US Embassy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So ano po ang interest ng US sa FIVIDEC?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Last year,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: nagkaroon po tayo ng balikatan activity doon sa area.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So this year, kaugnay po ng hindi po solely US yun, may kasama din pong,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: ano na, tawag nito, 4th Infantry Division, hindi lang nagkaroon ng coordination doon sa area.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Kasi hindi po pwedeng magamit yung PBDEC mismo kasi hindi po environmentally cleared ng DNR yung area.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Malamang nag-a-access lang po sila.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Nag-a-access lang po sila para makita yung bay.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Pero ganun pa man, hindi sila pinayagan ng Philippine Army na pumasok dahil sa lack of coordination.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: At mahigpit po yung bilin sa Philippine Army dahil po the area is not environmentally cleared by PNRI and DENR.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We cannot take the risk of people going in there and getting whatever—uh, whatever disease.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So ano pong interest ng US military sa area na yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Do they also want to have access or use to the facilities that will be put up?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That is purely balikatan, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Balikatan?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yeah, a loading exercise which happened last year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero posible rin po na gamitin ng US Navy kung sakaling maitayo na yung dry dock, pwede rin nilang gamitin?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Sa atin lang po puno na yun eh. Kaya kailangan din na po natin.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So I don't see any space for expansion on that area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So you do not see that it is?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: No, Your Honor. We need to have our own dedicated dry dock actually.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Ngayon, yugnay ko na po sa Pax Silica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Nabanggit nyo kanina na hindi kayo directly involved dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero yung Pax Silica, as the US explains it, this has to do with securing the defense industrial base of the US.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung kanilang supply chain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Lalo na for semiconductors, especially given the importance of AI in economic as well as military competition with China.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So merong Pax Silica sa New Clark City. Magtatayo daw ng manufacturing facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Bukod doon, nage-expand ang US ng kanyang not just military but also civilian or dual-use presence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So halimbawa yung Subic, regular na ginagamit ng US Navy for repairs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung recent na destroyer ng US na nawala ng kuryente for four days in the South China Sea, dinala yan sa Subic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa Mindanao, sa Davao Gulf, magtatayo daw ng oil depot ang US para sa kanila, sa US Navy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito po ang tanong ko. Kasi Pax Silica, data and so on. Pinakita po sa gera sa Iran that in the 21st century, with the use of drones and missiles,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ay pinakita ng Iran na winasak niya yung US Navy base in Bahrain, yung Manama base, kaya namumuroblema yung mga aircraft carrier nila ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi masuplayan. Inataki din ng Iran, di lang yung mga military bases ng US, kung hindi pati yung mga commercial facilities ng US in the area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: For example, yung mga data centers ng Amazon at saka ng Oracle in places like UAE and Kuwait.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang tanong ay, napakaraming mga pasilidad natin ngayon na may presensya ng US, both military and civilian.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Subic, yung Davao possibly, and itong New Clark City. Ngayon, kung sakaling magkaroon ng gera sa pagitan ng US at China,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: sa issue ng Taiwan, pwede po nating mahiduha na tatarget, katulad ng ginawa ng Iran sa Middle East,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ay tatargetin ng China ang mga pasilidad, both military as well as commercial, ng US sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ang concern po natin, yung mga presensya ng US sa Pilipinas ay nasa mga strategic and critical economic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At yung mga infrastructure natin, Subic, New Clark City, ay yung planong joint ammunition facility sa, I think also Subic,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: between the US and the Philippine Armed Forces, Davao possibly kung mayroong fuel depot doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So in other words, pwedeng maging target ito. It is logical to assume na yan ang unang-unang tatargetin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng China kung sakaling magkaroon ng gera with the US.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The question here is, ano ang kakayahan ng armed forces na depensahan ang mga pasilidad na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasi ang nangyari in the Gulf, in the Middle East, ay nawasak po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: There is huge economic damage to the economies of the Gulf.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sila mayamang bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: High-tech missile defenses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Paano po ang Pilipinas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, at risk ang mga buhay ng Pilipino at ang ekonomiya ng Pilipinas

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: dahil sa lumalawak na presensya ng US at lalo pang lalawak, halimbawa kung matuloy ang Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, di ba pinag-iisipan ito ng DND?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At paano mapoprotektahan?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Sa laban po ng marami sa katanungan, I understand the point of the representative.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: First, doon po sa hinggil sa China threat.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Whether or not meron tayong mga alyansa, kalinsabay ng Amerika bilang treaty partner,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: may overt acts na po ang China na may balakin sila sa atin.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Lately nga po.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ang kanilang statement na gagawa sila ng maritime observatory sa Scarborough, sa Bajo de Masinloc

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: na maliwanag po, wala silang karapatan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: At ang pagtatawag nga po nila ng island, Tau is island, dito sa Seoul,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: maybe presages, pre-messages an intention to fortify it.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Just like they did in Mischief Reef.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, given that, may choice po tayo na itutuloy po ng China ang kanilang ginagawa na wala tayong gagawin

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: or kukuha tayo ng kaalyado.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ang sagdanang amin po sa DND, the more we can do resilience with as many partners as possible

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: in the quickest amount of time, given the fact na assumption po namin na may balak ang China

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: because geographically,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: ang Pilipinas lang ang tanging hadlang sa China, sa Pacific Ocean.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Secondly, kahit na po sa Pacific Islands, nababahala na rin po ang dati nga na nakikipag-ayos sa kanila,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Solomon Islands, na nagpabagsak sila ng ballistic missile doon na may kukunting warning.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Pati po Australia and New Zealand,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: na napakalayo na po, ay nababahala din kasi ang supply chains nila na-threaten

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: at ang activities ng China doon sa lugar na yon ay patent.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, alam ko po yung punto ng ating congressman na will the alliances presage or be a precursor to a Chinese attack.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I believe.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That since China has already by overt action its intention to the Philippines,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: it's beside the point already, it's either you be co-opted or not.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Now, to build defense resilience, we know that it is a very expensive proposition and growing more expensive every day.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Which is why also countries like Australia and Japan,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and South Korea for that matter and Canada as distant as that feel that their supply chains are threatened and France as distant as that and India for that matter who although pound for pound they can match the People's Liberation Army,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: there is still a lot of shall we say,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: defense spending going on in there because of their neighbors that are also being accommodated within that axis.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: sa akin pong palagay ang pagpapalawak ng alyansa at pagdedevelop ng más resilient supply chain lalo na sa critical technologies

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: na,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: nga,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I really am not familiar with the corporate workings of Paxilica but the end product we need and we need the supply chain as fast as possible because the experience has it in combat areas, they need to retool this every three days and perhaps even faster with AI.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's either we adopt the technology and try to use it as best as possible as we can or be taken over.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: taken over by the technology without anything happening.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So I know it is a debate which there is – there are concerns, however, in view of the fact

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: that we see the – and not only us, even Vietnam sees it, even other countries see

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: the expansion of China.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And given the fact that we have already tried the latest attempt, ang latest pagsubok yung

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: pag-file natin ng delineation ng ating maritime waters sa ITLOS under the UN, eh dito naman

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: tayo talagang nakatutok.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But at the end of the day, we also need to stand up for –

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: as best as we can for the territorial integrity and sovereignty of the country in the face

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: of overt attempts by China.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Even as the gentleman raised earlier, yung pagpapalit ng naratibo sa Batanes, by a

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: state university, part and parcel ng UFW ng China ito eh.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: At ito'y realisasyon, hindi lang ng Pilipinas, pero maraming bansa.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, sabi'ng pong palagay ay kesa sa wala tayong kapabilidad na to deter, no?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Because the exercise is in deterrence, eh, rather than in reaction.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's what we're trying to do as best as we can.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, salamat po sa katanungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Cong. Tinio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: And finally, uh, the last person to interpolate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Madam?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes. Uh, Cong. Pleyto was registered for the first round.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: He would like to, um, ask his questions as well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: But if it's okay, with the indulgence of Cong. Pleyto, may we recognize Cong. Sarah?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maigli lang po dahil tayo rin po ay magsisponsor ng isang bill ngayon sa plenaryo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang question ko po ay saan po kumukuha ang AFP ng PONDO para sa kanyang mga learning tours?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron po bang learning tours?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Learning tours?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Educational trips?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Meron po education budget at meron naman po grants.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: All right.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: institutional arrangements with other countries like Australia, India, the United States, Japan, and Korea

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: for professional military education like cadets.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But we see the need to have to invest on a department level

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and on the military level for higher education on multidisciplinary aspects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Okay. Ang katanungan ko, Madam Chair, ay tungkol doon sa mga learning tours

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: involving educational institutions as well as other institutions for learning

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na hino-host po natin dito sa bansa. May specific line item po ba para sa bansa?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ito ay reserve force development po. Pero yung courses po sa education,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: eh, wala pong budget para doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Okay. Sige. Hingin na lang po natin yung kopya ng report kung paano yan ginagastas.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: These are the ROTC programs, actually.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Natanong natin ito, Madam Chair, kasi po, may concern din po na nilapit sa amin ng mga child rights advocates.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Naghanda po kami ng ibang photos ng mga nakaabot sa atin na ulat

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na meron daw pong mga educational tours na hino-host ang ating military

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kung saan dinaduluhan po ng mga bata na sila po ay pinapahawak ng mga baril.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Opo. So, ito po ay tatlong instance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang mga detalye. Pero nandyan na po yan lahat. Pero ang katanungan ko po ay bakit po pinapahintulutan ito ng DND at AFP?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Duly noted, Your Honor. Hindi dapat talaga umano yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Duly noted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Chair, nakapost pa po ito sa social media. At nakakabahala po kasi marami ng mga conventions.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ako rin po nababahala dito. At hindi po po ito tolerate yung ganyang gawain. Whether posted or non-posted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Chair, ang partner po dito sa Bukidnon, halimbawa Child Development Center,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ibig sabihin po nasa six years old below yung mga participants niyan. So, ganun po ka-bata.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya dapat may malinaw na palisiya na maipagbawal po yung ganitong paghahawak ng baril ng mga bata.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lalo na po sa mga incidents ngayon sa mga eskwelahan. Kung saan malaking issue ang gun access at ang safety po ng ating mga bata at kabataan sa ating mga bata.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: This is what I will do, Your Honor. I'll ask the DSWD to work with us to lecture to the units what are the proper engagement parameters for the youth under 18.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pati po sa mga bata, dapat po matiyak natin na wala pong ganito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yun nga po, yung minoritidad. As legally defined.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I will ask the DSWD to, which we have close working relationships with.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: This is something that I cannot tolerate, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron po ba tayo sa inyong mga standards pagdating sa pag-uphold ng ating responsibility?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron po bang parusa yung ganitong tipo ng mga paglabag?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ito po gawa ng palagay ko sa pagpapalit ng mission area ngayon ay lack of awareness ito.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Ngunit ako po ay personal kong...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I papaloap ito at i-dedirect ko ang Undersecretary for Defense Administration to take charge of this.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: This should not happen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yes, Madam Chair. Dapat po mahigpit yan na maipagbawal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Madam Chair, tungkol dun sa mga na-report po na ulat ng sexual assault within the military.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napalakas na po ba natin halimbawa yung mga mechanisms for sexual assault prevention?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para po matiyak na yung mga kaso, mga complaints na iimbestigahan at natitiyak natin na may pananagutan?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That is one area po na nagtutulungan din po kami sa DSWD.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Kasi victim identification is also very important.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And it's certainly something that we really cannot tolerate.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Whether it is...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: ah...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: heterosexual or otherwise.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: In this regard, Madam Chair, I'd like to put on record our request for the DND as well as all its attached agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: to submit its compliance report on its gender and development mandate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mahalaga po yan dahil malaking bahagi din ang ating pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: And lastly, Madam Chair, alam ko po patapos na rin po yung aking oras.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At tungkol po sa deployment ng Civil-Military Operations Battalion

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa Metro Manila at sa ating mga siyudad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May guiding principles, may policies po ba ang DND tungkol dito?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Meron po.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Lalo-lalo na ngayon ang major threat area po na pinagtututukan po nila ay ang United Front Works.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It's against foreign influence.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We now have a consolidated CMO command.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Which takes threats to national security on a more information-based basis.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And now the major concentration is on foreign malign influence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Naintindihan po natin yung may kinalaman dun sa mga threats pagdating sa national security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero may mga nakaabot din po tayo na balita na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa po, subject ng House Resolution No. 1203,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung presence po ng 12 Civil-Military Operations Battalion sa Marikina, sa Caloocan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At may mga balita po, halimbawa, pinapapunta yung isang nanay na nagsasalita tungkol sa karapatan niya sa pabahay

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na pinapatawag po at pinapasurrender.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So yung ganitong tipo po ng mga kaso, dapat sa tingin po natin, dahil nagdadala ng tensyon, ng takot dun sa mga kababayan natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na wala namang kinalaman sa external threats, wala namang kinalaman sa threats sa ating national security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: In fact, ang hinaharap nila, threats sa kanilang housing, threats sa kanilang livelihood.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sila po yung naapektuhan ng presence ng ganitong tipo ng batalyon sa kanilang mga lugar.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Doon po sa usapin na yan, of course, internal security is also part and parcel nito.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Part and parcel din ng CMO batalyon operations po ito.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: What I can guarantee, Your Honor, is that we have to really also marshal our resources into something more tangible,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: given the fact that the President himself has said that we need to pinch each and every peso right now.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Given that, Your Honor, that's why we already created the CMO command on a national level,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: so to have a more structured approach to information dissemination and to combat foreign malign information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yes, Madam Chair, kasi ang nangyayari dito, parang wala ho tayong tiwala dun sa civilian bureaucracy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: tsaka sa local police natin para ma…

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ma-care of yung ganitong tipo ng mga usapin, kung meron man.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At we'll take the word of the Secretary on this. At sana rin po, hindi lang po sa DND, dito rin po sa Kongreso,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sana ho hindi natin mapalagpas na mapag-usapan ang mga mahalagang resolusyon na ito para matiyak ang…

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maliwanag po yung pinakita na may bata na may armas eh, yan di ko po…

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Of course, yes. Opo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero pagdating po dito sa presence din ng CMO,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa presence din po ng military sa ating mga communities, dapat may malinaw na pabantayan.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Especially with the incidents of school shootings in Zamboanga, then you have this kind of things.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I cannot allow that to happen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yes. Maraming salamat, Madam Chair. At abangan po natin yung mga hiningi nating reports tungkol sa TICAS implementation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: gayon din po sa lahat ng affected ng fishing ban na may kinalaman sa balikatan exercises, at iba pa nating mga hiningi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Manghingi na din po tayo ng status report tungkol po sa presence ng 12th CMO dito sa Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Chair. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Kong Sarah. Before we move to our last interpellator, we'd like to recognize Congressman Isidro Ungab.

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Actually, I have no question. I came here to support the budget of the DND and the AFP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: Just to one matter, I would like to, uh—

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: After this, may I request for a

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: three minutes, uh, short meeting with the DND chief and Chief of Staff, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Isidro T. Ungab
segments.text: This is a parochial concern about my district. Very, very short. Three minutes lang. I have prepared already the summary. Thank you, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, former chair of appropriations, Manong Sid.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Kong Sid. So, for our last interpellator, I would like to recognize Kong Salvador Pleyto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Madam Chair, gusto kong munang… wala na na… wala na na iwan. Ako na yata lahat sa ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Ating Secretary, ang idol ko, Secretary Gibo Teodoro. I've known him for… tagal pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Bago kang pasa ng bar, doon tayo sa San Miguel, palagi kayo si Manong Junior, Jun D. Kaya kabisado ko po. Hindi po tayo… kayo po one of the most, if not the most, brilliant.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: The most brilliant member of the cabinet. Totoo po yun. Totoo po ito. Hindi ako nagsisip-sip kasi ayaw niya ng sip-sip eh. Kabisado ko yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Wala akong ilinalapit po dyan kay isekretary. Kailangang kaibigan ko yan matagal na. Kaya patingin ko rin po si chief of staff. Hindi na rin napariti sa mga kasama. Hindi ko na sila isa-isahin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Isekretary, ang Department of National Defense po ang pangunahing ahinsya para sumaya naman tayo ng National Disaster Response.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Saludo po ako sa agarang pagkakataon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: At ngayon magkilos ngayon ng ating mga NDRR-CMOCD lalong-lalong na po yung kanilang warning. Ito eh pang mahihirap pang mayaman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Na naririnig natin through our phones, our cell phones. Kung minsan nakakagulat po ito, eh. Nagugulat tayo, pero napakaganda po nitong ganitong sistema para, Madam Chair, mabigyan natin agad ng babala ang mga kababayan, lalo na mga mahihirap, pagdating ng mga kalamidad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: [unclear]

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: malakas na ulan. Sa Disaster and Institutional Research Program, na nabanggit mo kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Sekretary, nandito ako sa briefing kanina umaga, palipat-lipat po kami sabay-sabay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Sinabi ni Secretary Teodoro, Madam Chair, kasama rin po dito ang pagsaludo namin sa ating

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: kasundaluhan. Kasi po, sa ground, kapag may lindol, bagyo, o malawakang pagbaha,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: ang unang humaharap sa ating mga kababayan ay kasama ng mga LGUs ay mga sundalo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Hindi sila inaantalang panganib sa paghahatid ng agarang tulong sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Kaya, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Madam Chair, Secretary, mayroon po akong hiling sa nga lang po ng aking mga kababayan sa Bulacan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: If I may, may I request the Department of National Defense and the OCD to strongly consider the preparedness of Bulacan and other highly populated flood-prone areas for a major earthquake or the big one,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: particularly the adequacy of the armed forces of the Philippines OCD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: So, umpisa ko po lang ah.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, the Chair gives...

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: The adequacy of the Armed Forces of the Philippines, OCD communications, rescue assets, and evacuation logistics when ordinary civilian infrastructure fails.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary. Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, thank you. And that was also the reason I was not able to attend the...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: President's visit to Pampanga yesterday because we had a meeting with the critical infrastructure providers and connectivity providers, telecoms companies, power companies, etc.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: to address how the OCD can facilitate their resilience measures to ensure...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: business process continuity during an earthquake.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It had also been raised that since the Metro Manila, about 60% of the economy, of the revenue of the economy is headquartered in Metro Manila and critical connectivity lies here.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: The...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: As...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: The distinguished representative is familiar, the Metro Manila Earthquake Impact Resilience Study is circa 2003.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And a lot has changed since then.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And we are...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I approved yesterday the JICA papers to be processed to the Cabinet for a revisiting of this earthquake impact study.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We already agreed that the shepherding institution will be the DOST.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That's step one because we have to ensure that in order for us to operate,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: that connectivity and other critical services continue.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: If not, we are hampered.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: On the Armed Forces side, Your Honor, we have the capability to operate.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We have the capability to operate even except for major thoroughfares.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: If those are hampered, then our ability to access the areas may be hampered except by aerial capabilities.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We are also trying to also differentiate between two major earthquake...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: earthquake...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: sources.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: The West Valley Fault and the Manila Trench.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: On the impact of an earthquake in these areas.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Because in the Manila Trench, Your Honor, the effect will be a tsunami.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And in the West Valley Fault, as we are very familiar with, it will be subsidence, liquefaction, major damage to connectivity and to lives.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, I think it is healthy.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And although we cannot predict when it happens,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and according to Secretary Solidum, it happened historically every 400 to 500 years.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And give or take 200 years, but we are within that 200-year grace period.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Nonetheless, I think the earthquake...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: impact study is essential to have any properly engineered solution at least to allow first responders to access communities.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: On the issue of flooding, Your Honor, I think it is a major concern which needs major engineering.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: In an area which is now prone to liquefaction...

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: subsidence, and sea-level rise.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: The concern of Congresswoman Bondoc is shared also by my home province on the MacArthur Highway side.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: As Engineer Pleyto is very familiar with.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Because our home province not only receives runoff from the Sierra Madre.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: But also the Agno River and the Zambales Mountain Range.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: So, it is really a catch basin.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And unfortunately, Lahar had clogged our major thoroughfares.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And all I know, it needs a complex engineering solution.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Maybe requiring a new carriageway altogether.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And an elevated basis.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And we saw that in Typhoon Ondoy.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Where?

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We requested the MRT to work 24 hours because it was the only way on the initial stage that we could connect because of the flooding.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: That is a matter I undertook to raise as a major concern area on the national NDRRMC level.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: And on the NEDA level.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: I think it's high time.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Your Honor, that we have systems, engineered solutions for river systems, water systems, and for connectivity points.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: It needs to be engineered and it should be science-based.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: If not, it won't be sustainable, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: That's right, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Secretary, I know that during my time, I'm with JICA studies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: We're with Secretary Solidum.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: When I was the Regional Director of Public Works dito sa NCR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Gusto ko lang idagdag, Secretary, we have seen how the Philippine Air Force under the Lieutenant General Cordura

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: para yung pag-provide po nyo ng critical humanitarian assistance through sustained airlift operations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: May record po kasi ako dito yung June 12 to June 14, 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Where Philippine Air Force delivered 1,200 DSWD family packs, ready-to-eat packs, jerry cans filled with clean water to barangay's lagimit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: and aligado in the isolated municipality of Glan, in the Sarangani Province, including with clean water in barangay Aligado.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Ang ating ding magigiting na sundalo ay nagsasagawa ng humanitarian assistance disaster response sa pamamagitan ng mga sandbagging,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: ng tunituniladang buhangin sa mga apektadong bahagi ng ilog upang makatatag ang lugar at makatulong may iwasan karagdagang pinsaladulot ang habagat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: yung southwest monsoon rain sa lalawigan ng Tarlac, yung baya ng ating sekretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Maganda rin po ang nasabi ninyo kanina, yung system of pre-positioning your assets before it's a disaster strike na kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: rather than bringing them only after the calamity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Kaya po, nonetheless, Secretary, congratulations po sa DND family for a job well done.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: And for this, I strongly support the approval of the DND budget for the year 2027. Thank you, Mr. Chair, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: We thank the distinguished representative from Bulacan, a friend of longstanding, and although an adopted son of Bulacan,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: [unclear] taga-Amianan [unclear] umay-ayos [unclear] po, [unclear] puso na po.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: [unclear] po. Agyaman kami nga unay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Kong Tito. Meeting is suspended for a few minutes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: We would like to recognize Chairperson Mika Suansing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, Vice Chair Bella Suansing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Um, thank you for presiding over today’s budget briefing for the Department of National Defense.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Um, thank you for—very, uh—for doing a good job in managing it. Um, and I’m happy

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: that, um, everything, uh, went smoothly today. Um, and Sec, I—I left you in very able hands. Um, and, uh,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: hopefully, the—the—the DND family is happy with your budget sponsor. [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: But she will be—she will be with you po. She will be your partner until the plenary, um, until, uh,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: until we defend the—the budget of the Department of National Defense. Um, Sec,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I just wanted to, uh, make maybe a manifestation of support, um, for—for the budget of the Department

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: of National Defense. Um, as you know po, even last year, um, I was a staunch advocate for—for helping

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: um, the Department with, um, the—the budgetary requirements, whichever needed to be restored

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: from the NEP to HGAB to the bicam to the GAA. So, um, the same po, uh, as last year, I’ll be your partner

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: din po, um, in advocating for

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: uh, any other budgetary needs, uh, the Department may have. So, Sec, I’ll request po if, um, if I may ask,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: uh, if—if there are particular programs or projects that were not included in the NEP that are

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: critical for the Department of National Defense and all of the attached agencies, so that I—I could

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: also help, um, uh, advocate for it. We also have members of the BARC who are here with me, members of the

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Budget Amendments Review

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Subcommittee. We will be deliberating on all of these requests po, uh, uh, openly, uh, line by line, um, in—in—in the

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: next few weeks. So, Sec, if I may ask po, um, if there are any priority projects or programs that were left

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: out from the NEP that you would like us to consider po for—for restoration in the HGAB.

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: Madam Chair, of immediate concern would be the capital outlays that, uh, were reduced from us because, as you know,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: on the Department level, uh, also on the, uh, uh, AFP level, any item of, uh, equipment we receive needs the

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: appropriate capital outlay to support the infrastructure. On the DND, uh, we had to vacate

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: our building, which is 70 years old, and everybody was getting sick. So we, uh—the capital outlay was reduced,

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: and it will also impact the timeline for the

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: extension and the, uh, restoration of the legacy building, which we cannot touch

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: because of its, uh, historic, uh, value. Uh, and the rest of the needs will be, uh, communicated

segments.speaker: DND Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr.
segments.text: to the, uh, distinguished chairperson and vice chairperson by, uh, Undersecretary [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much po. If I may request po for a—for formal letter, um, coming from the Department of National Defense

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: um, so that I may submit that for the consideration of the Budget Amendments

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
